name: classroompath
description: ClassroomPath SaaS - DNS whitelist management for educational institutions
author: balejosg

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd upstream/openpath && npm install
scripts.build:api: cd upstream/openpath && npm run build --workspace=@openpath/shared && npm run build --workspace=@openpath/api
scripts.build:spa: cd upstream/openpath && npm run build --workspace=@openpath/shared && npm run build --workspace=openpath-spa
